title: Green Light
intro: Eight minutes, any day you like. It keeps the range you already have, and it's short enough that you'll actually do it. Nothing in here is held, so it's fine in the hour before you play. It won't warm you up for a hit or a speed session though, and the On-Court list has the session for that.

Think of this as the short daily version, with nothing held. Daily Mobility Flow in this list is the fifteen minute one with long holds, so do that when you have the time and it isn't the hour before you play. The other mobility sessions are the ones that change something. Stiff and heavy the morning after a hard match? The day-after session in the Recovery list is built for that.

before.label: Lower back
before.text: If your lower back is the problem, get it looked at first. The bodyweight back session in the Care list is there once someone has cleared you.

before.label: Stop and get it checked
before.text: Pain down a leg, numbness, weakness in a leg or foot, or numbness between your legs. If your bladder or bowel control changes, get seen the same day.
